title: User Interface
description: Build interactive menus, audio sliders, dialogue prompts, and data-driven HUD overlays.

blocks.content: User Interface behaviors turn screen-space layers, sprites, and text entities into interactive menus, HUD overlays, dialogue boxes, and data-driven grids.

items.title: Interactive Controls
items.desc: Build animated buttons, draggable audio sliders, toggle switches, and branching visual novel dialogue prompts.

items.title: Data-Driven HUD & Grids
items.desc: Bind live variables to text labels, animate health and progress bars, and populate inventory grids from prefab templates.

rows: Create clickable buttons, volume sliders, toggle switches, and interactive dialogue choices.
Bind gameplay variables to HUD text, animate fill bars, and spawn data-bound inventory grids.
Configure font families, sizes, alignment, and live variable binding on UI labels.
Create screen-space UI layers with parallax locked at zero so HUD elements stay fixed to the camera.
Browse all UI widget, slider, dialogue, and grid spawning blueprint nodes.
